info.title: CLIR Credit Line Increase Business Objects
info.description: Business objects for the Automated Credit Line Increase Request (CLIR) process application, sourced from IBM_BAW_PDD_Credit_Line_Increase.docx.

CustomerInfo.description: Account-holder credit line request data captured at submission.

fullName.description: Full legal name of account holder.

requestedIncrease.description: Target requested credit limit. Must be greater than currentLimit.

status.description: Request lifecycle status. Values: SUBMITTED, IN_REVIEW, COMPLETED, ESCALATED.

RiskAssessment.description: Automated risk evaluation result from the Risk Assessment Engine.

riskLevel.description: Evaluation result. Values: LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK, AUTO_REJECT.

autoApproved.description: True when the request passed the automated rule check.

riskReason.description: Detailed reason code or description for the evaluation result.

assessedDate.description: Timestamp when the risk assessment completed.

status.description: Assessment run status. Values: COMPLETE, ERROR.

ApprovalDecision.description: Final or intermediate approval decision set by rules, underwriter, or system.

status.description: Decision status. Values: APPROVED, REJECTED, PENDING_UNDERWRITER, ESCALATED, INTEGRATION_ERROR.

approverComments.description: Notes and rationale from underwriter or system engine.

processedBy.description: User ID or system service account executing the decision.

processedDate.description: Timestamp when the decision was recorded.
